_note: Public template. Copy to axon-overlay/config/comms.json and fill real values there — never here. comms resolves config from $AXON_COMMS_CONFIG > $AXON_PERSONAL_ROOT/config/comms.json > capabilities/comms/comms.config.json at runtime (see src/config.rs Config::load). Every field is optional; the tool runs zero-config against the shared local Postgres with only the built-in classification heuristics.
_comment_database: Postgres connection string. Leave unset to auto-build one from axon-overlay/config/postgres.env (capabilities/postgres, the shared local instance). Set only to point at a different instance.
_comment_google_env: Path to the KEY=value env file holding GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET / GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN (mint the refresh token once via auth/get-refresh-token.ts). Defaults to $AXON_PERSONAL_ROOT/config/comms.env. Gmail is READ-ONLY in this build.
_comment_api_secret: Shared secret for mutating routes (POST /ingest, POST /feed/:id/status, etc). Path to a file containing the bearer token (or JSON with auth.api_key). Required for write endpoints. Generate a private file with: openssl rand -hex -out path/to/file 32 && chmod 600 path/to/file. The local dashboard's Vite proxy reads this same reference at startup and injects it server-side; browser JavaScript never receives the value. Restart Comms and the dashboard after rotating it. The browser extension and direct CLI calls also use this value.
_comment_enrichment_drain_minutes: How often comms-server drains the summary backlog, in minutes (default 15). Ingest-triggered enrichment only reaches items that arrive while the inference server is up; without this pass, items ingested during an outage stay empty until someone runs `comms summarize --pending` by hand. The retry ledger bounds it: three failed attempts with exponential backoff, each failure recording its error class. Set 0 to disable when something else owns the schedule.
_comment_quality_flags: Computed review-queue thresholds. Passing extraction fixtures retain 39.7–89.6% of total raw text, preserve 100% judged useful text, and leak 0% judged boilerplate; the defaults round that observed total-retention envelope outward to 39–90% and keep leakage at 0%. summary_attempt_warning=2 flags the attempt before the existing three-attempt cap parks an item. Flagging never calls a provider or enriches an item.
_comment_keeper_export_dir: Optional directory. When set, `comms keep <id>` also writes a distilled markdown note (title, url, date, summary — never the raw transcript). Leave unset to disable export.
_comment_inference: Comms asks the shared inference.json for the 'summarization', 'embedding' and 'reranking' roles. Backend URLs, model ids, prefixes and key-file references belong in <overlay>/config/inference.json, never here. A missing reranker preserves semantic scores; a missing embedding role degrades to explicitly labelled lexical relevance.
_comment_relevance: General Feed personalization. profile_paths accepts exact Markdown files or non-recursive directories of focus lenses. Embedding selects lens candidates; reranking scores those query-document pairs.
_comment_travel_context: Optional read-only Trips context for Feed ranking. Comms reads the existing Trips HTTP API, retains only a bounded snapshot of upcoming plan title, destinations, dates and interests, and keeps using the last successful snapshot during a temporary outage. Traveler names and itinerary payloads are not copied.
_comment_vault_link_sources: Explicit Markdown files that may supply Feed links. Never point this at the vault root. heading limits a messy note such as Scratchpad.md to one deliberate section and stops at the next heading of the same or higher level. A missing heading returns zero candidates. Fenced code, frontmatter and credential-looking URLs are ignored.
_comment_feed_sources: General Feed collectors. Omit this field to use the public GitHub Trending daily and recent arXiv AI defaults; set [] to disable all. arxiv.query uses the official arXiv search_query grammar. limit is bounded by each adapter. Personal saved queries belong only in axon-overlay.
_comment_rules: Config-driven classification rules, evaluated first (first match wins) before the built-in heuristics. Each rule: { match: { from_contains?: [..], subject_contains?: [..], has_list_unsubscribe?: bool }, stream: one of aktiv|issue|feed|werbung|belege|steuern|sonstiges, note: '<one-line rationale>' }. Keep anything personal (real sender addresses) in the private overlay, never here.
